content.text:
I've submitted index 15 (In 0.49 / Sb 0.51) as the best composition. It gave the highest EQE of the three I measured, 0.0871%, but the lead is small and I can't tell how close it is to the library's best.

The budget allowed only three EQE measurements. Before each one I checked the models: MACE for whether the phase is stable, and MEGNet for its predicted band gap.

| Index | In / Sb | Why I picked it | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 | 0.49 / 0.51 | InSbO4: stable, predicted gap 2.2 eV | **0.0871** |
| 6 | 0.79 / 0.21 | In11Sb3O24: stable, smallest predicted gap (1.9 eV) | 0.0793 |
| 11 | 0.63 / 0.37 | Mix of the two phases above; the model's top suggestion for the last measurement | 0.0792 |

- **Close results:** all three values are within about 10% of each other.
- **Gap prediction didn't pay off:** the smallest predicted gap (index 6) did not give the highest EQE.
- **Unmeasured compositions:**
  - **In-rich end:** never measured.
  - **Sb-rich end:** also never measured. I judged it less promising because the Sb-rich phase In3Sb5O12 is slightly unstable and its predicted gap (2.77 eV) is above the 2.4 eV light.
- **XRD:** I used none of the 5 XRD measurements, so the phases at each composition were never confirmed.
